login.title: Login
login.required: You need to log in to use this feature.
login.heading: Ready to Play?
login.subtitle: Log in to book courts, find matches, and message other players.
login.quote: The fastest way to get on the court.

register.title: Create an account
register.name: Full name
register.subtitle: Register to find matches and book venues today.
register.verificationNotice: After registering, you will receive a verification email. Check your inbox and activate your account before logging in.

validation.passwordMin: Password must be at least 6 characters
validation.passwordMin8: Password must be at least 8 characters
validation.nameMin: Name must be at least 2 characters

forgot.title: Forgot Password?
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we will send you a password reset link.
forgot.sentTo: We sent a password reset link to
forgot.expiryNotice: The link is valid for 15 minutes. Check your spam folder if you do not see it.

reset.invalidLinkToast: The password reset link is invalid.
reset.invalidLinkDescription: The password reset link is invalid or has expired.
reset.title: Reset Password
reset.subtitle: Create a strong new password for your account.
reset.newPasswordPlaceholder: At least 8 characters, 1 uppercase letter, 1 number
reset.successDescription: Your password has been updated. You can now log in with your new password.

verify.title: Verify Email
verify.sentDescription: We sent a verification link to your email. Open the email and select the link to activate your account.
verify.expiryNotice: The verification link is only valid for a limited time.
verify.successDescription: Your email has been verified. You can now log in and start finding matches.

errors.invalid: The verification link is invalid. Register again or contact support.
errors.used: This link has already been used. Please log in.
errors.expired: This link has expired. Register again to receive a new link.
errors.userNotFound: The account does not exist. Please register.
errors.default: An error occurred. Try again or contact support.

api.registerVerifyEmail: Registration successful. Verify your email before logging in.
api.resetLinkSent: A password reset link has been sent to your email.
